name: @kernlize/applet-samples
description: Notes, Pulse and Profiles: three sample applets built from one page, with manifests signed by a throwaway key at build time

scripts.build: vite build --mode notes && vite build --mode pulse && vite build --mode profiles && node scripts/ship.mjs
scripts.verify: pnpm test:guidance && pnpm build && pnpm test:unit && pnpm type-check
